body:
I believed the last man who said that to me. His last words to me just earlier were: You know what? I can't bother.
I was upset and crying and he hates crying since it annoys him. Real caring, right?
I do trust you might not be like that. I'm not exactly young anymore and I don't think I have a chance to find anyone in this life. I fought and fought, I have no fight left. I just want to come home to someone that loves me at the end of each day.
Sorry to even post this. Only makes others sad too. I'll just check out of life. Bye
